nodes.label: Refine audio warning UI in downloader
details: Implemented temporary warning chip on URL bar when toggling audio mode ON.
Refined visual transition using framer-motion and removed shadow glow.
Ensured warning only triggers when switching TO audio mode.

fileEdits.reason: Added warning state to URL chip and improved animations without nested borders.
Added trigger logic for audio warning state, only firing when toggled ON.

nodes.label: Non-blocking Toast ConfirmDialog
details: Pivoted dialog from centered modal to non-blocking toast notification in bottom-right corner.
Implemented 'blurred fill' header to fix black-bar issues on non-conforming thumbnails.
Refined proportions to a tall 'literal card' silhouette (370px wide, 4/3 aspect header).
Switched to purely text-based ghost buttons for a premium, understated aesthetic.
Integrated title/message directly under the image with minimal spacing.
Added red dotted border detail to action area for tactile 'card' feel.
Ensured context menu closes immediately upon triggering confirmation flow.

fileEdits.reason: Redesigned as non-blocking toast with blurred-fill header, minimal text actions, and dotted border detail.
Immediate menu closure on delete trigger; passing preview context to toast.
